instructions: On Fleet, use a task-bound private preview checkout, retain the recipe, sources and originals, and submit them with design_offer. The owner chooses before a separate worker implements the accepted option. On other projects, create the requested design result (mockups, visuals, graphics, design book) under the project's rules. Retain outputs in output/. Do not use subagents. Read the principles card at the top of the project's docs/design-system/owner-rules.md first, where the project has one, and follow it.
